issue: Container default float32 GEMM precision is high and allow_tf32=True; .float() alone did not guarantee strict FP32 math
observed_via: docker exec bprsi-fa4-gpu0 python: torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 and torch.get_float32_matmul_precision
affected_scope: Previous runs based on benchmarks/run.py reference and compatibility.py before explicit precision setting; their numerical checks are development evidence with unverified/TF32 reference precision, not strict FP32 qualification
correction: Explicit highest/allow_tf32=False before reference creation; record readback in run environment; rerun numerical gates and source reproduction under fixed oracle. Thresholds unchanged
research_v1_note: Published research edition local FP32-validation descriptions need this precision qualification; external author results remain their attributed claims. Final edition must include this erratum
release_implication: No previous numerical success promotes a release without corrected current evidence
